Street guides / 06

Open, closed, free: the small print matters

A large sign names a place. A small notice can change what you should do next.

Updated 2 October 2026

휴무

Understand the place

영업중 means open for business. 휴무 means a day off or closure. 금연 means no smoking, and 주차장 identifies a parking area. 무료 means free of charge. These expressions often appear on doors, small boards, or notices rather than the main shop sign.

Easy to mix up

무료 describes the item or service it is attached to; it does not make everything nearby free. Likewise, a lit storefront is not a substitute for checking a 휴무 notice. Look for the complete phrase and any dates, times, or conditions written alongside it.

A sign you might see

무료 주차

무료 주차 means free parking: 무료 tells you the charge, and 주차 tells you what it applies to. There may be additional conditions on the notice. Read the whole notice or ask before assuming there is no time limit or purchase requirement.

Try it on your next walk

Pair 영업중 with 휴무, then say which one invites you to check the entrance. Find 금연 and describe the action it prohibits. In the quiz, look at the small notice as carefully as the shop itself.
